description: Importing NANSEN dev file adapters (adapters.import with a dev adapter instead of a document): a class subclassing nansen.dataio.FileAdapter (its .m file) and a function-based adapter (its +Name folder with fileadapter.json, read.m and write.m) become project file adapters with legacyFileAdapter, MATLAB only, their code copied into matlab/ in the same packages; the title, description (Description, or the help text), extensions (SUPPORTED_FILE_TYPES as written, with or without the dot) and data type are read from the text. A class built on one of dev's own adapters (TiffPlus, on its ImageStack) keeps that adapter's file types and data type, and names it (base) and the adapter here of each file type (builtIn). A folder of them brings those that are adapters and names the others. A function, a class built on a class of dev's that is not one of its adapters (DynamicFileAdapter) and a missing file are refused; an id that is taken is refused, also for a folder, and nothing is written then.
